articles.summary: Chart has receieved an award by Bechtel Energy for the supply of air-cooled and brazed aluminum heat exchangers, and cold boxes for Sempra Infrastructure’s Port Arthur LNG Phase 2 development project in Jefferson County, Texas.
articles.title: Chart selected for US LNG project

articles.summary: Successful delivery of large reciprocating compressor packages to leading Indian customers. The compressors were built at Chart’s Howden facility in the Netherlands with Howden India supplying the balance of the packages.
articles.title: Chart supplies hydrogen compressors in India
